offence_note: Two counts possession of cocaine for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: the sentence in relation to the March offence will be five years consecutive to the sentence imposed for the January offences.
note: Four years for January offence less 43 months credit leaves 5 months; plus 5 years consecutive.

offence_note: Possession of methamphetamine for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I find an appropriate sentence to be 18 months' imprisonment and a term of 12 months' probation to follow.
note: Father Cree; Gladue submissions found notably thin.

offence_note: Attempted murder by stabbing a stranger
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal but I would dismiss the appeal.
note: Trial judge gave no credit for remand time; appeal court accepted equivalence.

sentence_quote: On 12 July 2000, he sentenced the appellant to life imprisonment with no eligibility for parole for twenty years.
note: Appeal only against parole ineligibility period; dismissed.

offence_note: Break and enter with intent to commit criminal harassment
sentence_quote: Mr. Cook, I am imposing upon you a conditional discharge and a three‑year probation order.
note: Victim surcharge waived; schizophrenia diagnosed after offence.

offence_note: Theft of truck, arson over $5,000, failure to comply with undertaking
sentence_quote: comprised of six months open custody followed by three months in the community
note: Youth custody and supervision order of nine months; six months custody, three in community.

offence_note: Dangerous driving causing death and two counts causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: I pronounced a sentence of 15 months imprisonment on the count of dangerous driving causing death, and 11 months imprisonment concurrent on the two counts of dangerous driving causing bodily harm, and a two year driving prohibition.

offence_note: Second degree murder by shotgun of former employer
sentence_quote: On May 6, 2011, Mr. Justice Josephson sentenced him to life in prison with no eligibility of parole for 15 years
note: Epilepsy accepted as mitigating; age recognized but not significant.
